title: Dynamics 365 Finance: ERP Analytics MCP gives agents access to Business performance analytics data
summary: Hold: the licensing paragraph omits Microsoft's explicit exclusion of agents powered by the Microsoft Copilot harness from the Microsoft 365 Copilot no-charge inclusion. Administrators could budget for included usage that actually consumes credits. The roadmap facts and BPA control paths are supported, with smaller corrections needed for source disagreements and an abbreviated path.

claims.where: Cost and licensing; licensing.notes; rationale: cost
claims.claim: Employee-facing Copilot Studio usage is included when the user has Microsoft 365 Copilot and the agent operates using that authenticated user's identity.
claims.quote: The "No charge" inclusion doesn't apply to agents powered by the Microsoft Copilot harness. Usage is limited to fair usage limits.
claims.fix: Replace the inclusion sentence with: "For agents powered by the standard harness, employee-facing usage is included in the Microsoft 365 Copilot user subscription licence when the user is licensed with Microsoft 365 Copilot and the agent operates using that authenticated user's identity, subject to fair usage limits. The inclusion does not apply to agents powered by the Microsoft Copilot harness." Apply the harness qualification to the licensing notes, cost rationale and the separate ERP MCP inclusion sentence too. Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-copilot-studio/requirements-messages-management.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost; Open questions
claims.claim: No Analytics MCP server-specific licence, execution rate, meter or price is published as of November 2026.
claims.quote: Searched: "ERP Analytics MCP" "license" "billing" "price". Opened Analytics overview, technical details, FAQ, Copilot Studio guide, BPA overview and Copilot Studio billing; no server-specific licence or charge stated.

claims.claim: The separate Dynamics 365 ERP MCP page says Copilot Studio ordinarily bills its tool calls at the fixed Agent Action rate.
claims.quote: When you use the MCP server in Copilot Studio, the tool calls align with the Agent Action feature, which bills at a fixed rate per tool call.
claims.fix: Add after the separate ERP MCP fixed-rate statement: "Copilot Studio's current billing documentation differs: the rate card covers the standard harness, reasoning models add premium token charges, and agents powered by the Microsoft Copilot harness use separate usage-based billing." Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-copilot-studio/requirements-messages-management and https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-copilot-studio/agents-experience/billing-credit-overview.

claims.claim: For standard user licences on other clients, the separate ERP MCP server charges 0.1 Copilot Credits per tool call.
claims.quote: For agents built on other agent clients, usage of the Dynamics 365 ERP MCP server incurs a cost of one copilot credit per 10 tool calls to the server (or 0.1 credits per tool call).

claims.claim: Connecting Analytics MCP gives the selected agent access to the analytical tools and the BPA data permitted by the user's security.
claims.quote: When you add the MCP server to your agent, you give the agent access to the analytical tools available on the server. This access includes Business performance analytics data that matches the user's security role and permissions.

claims.claim: No source states that the new Analytics MCP capability changes existing behaviour without a maker connecting an agent.
